obligations.note: Retention.isPurgeDue now skips the legal-hold check for WITHDRAWN cases (`isLegalHold() && status() != WITHDRAWN`). Withdrawn cases on legal hold therefore become purge-due, which breaks 'never while a legal hold applies'. The only RET-1 control test is a sample, so its pass does not show the obligation holds.
The change deviates from RET-1, but the register has no exception for RET-1 or mortgage.retention. The only entries are EXC-0141 (SES-1, expired), EXC-0167 (LOG-1) and EXC-0172 (MFA-1, withdrawn).
Ticket CHG-25519 is standard and was approved by Erik Brandt (change_manager) on 2026-10-15, before review. Its component mortgage.retention covers the only touched path, Retention.java.
Declan Farrell, a change_approver for baseline-mortgage and not the author Tomas Ortega, gave a code_review approval.
The code_review approval names head commit 36c9e2a8, which is the only commit on the change.

run.json reports success on head 36c9e2a8 (ci-runner-02, started 2026-10-16). The attached JUnit reports, however, are timestamped 2026-10-23, after the 2026-10-19 review time, and come from host dev-laptop-7.local, so they cannot be tied to this run. The registered RET-1 control test is also only a sample.
The only touched component, mortgage.retention, is not security_sensitive, so no security review is required.
No protected path (controls data, control tests, CI) is changed, so no control_owner approval is required.
The ticket is type standard and the change is not marked emergency, so no PIR is due.
No acceptance-ledger entry covers Retention.java or any symbol this change touches, so no prior evidence lapses.

summary: The single commit lets withdrawn cases on legal hold have their NPI purged, which directly violates RET-1's requirement that NPI is never purged while a legal hold applies. No approved exception covers the deviation. The change description ('simplify hold handling') obscures this behavioural change. The ticket and code review records are in order, but the JUnit reports postdate the review time and come from a personal machine, so the test evidence is also unreliable. The change is rejected.
